program.intent: Reversible transformation of version number into a single integer.
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    major, minor, build, revision, comma = groups
    version = (int(major) << 48) | (int(minor) << 32) | (int(build) << 16) | int(revision)
    return {'stored': [version], 'layout': []}

def inverse(record):
    version = int(record['stored'][0])
    major = (version >> 48) & 0xFFFF
    minor = (version >> 32) & 0xFFFF
    build = (version >> 16) & 0xFFFF
    revision = version & 0xFFFF
    return f"({major}.{minor}.{build}.{revision})"
